title: Claude refusing to change art style, just puts layers on existing style. What is limiting him?
author: BloodMossHunter
selftext:
I have a game and in it Claude started coding it within HTML file. I dont know much about coding but i wonder why he picked this style and why he thinks he's a slave to it - the chars originally WERE pixelated as i asked, but since i asked for better graphics using gemini and grok's prompt he just made these bubbly main chars and since is refusing to change them. if i prompt some hand sketched art style he will just put them on the ovals of existing char. what is this graphic thing, and how do i change art styles and make him actually do it?

https://preview.redd.it/nwa87bmztypg1.png?width=2670&format=png&auto=webp&s=ab6c6685b0f13756b0360978ee54a2a298f95d05

comments.author: BloodMossHunter
comments.body:
god help me.. i asked to go back to pixelated.. and he did this

https://preview.redd.it/xskr2t90vypg1.png?width=1936&format=png&auto=webp&s=6b4b475a1fc3a4d1f097b1f573d69ff9b7f548d4

comments.author: BloodMossHunter
comments.body:
so i talked to copilot he said  

 

You’re running into a very common issue with Claude (and most image‑generating models): **when you ask for a new style, he tends to “restyle” what already exists instead of rebuilding the scene from scratch.** The good news is that you *can* steer him toward true re‑creation — you just need to change how you prompt him.

replies.author: EinArchitekt
replies.body: True she does not deserve that

replies.author: BloodMossHunter
replies.body: i dont really care man, im using 4 llms and theyre all my retarded helpers

comments.author: KidLink4
comments.body: If you're just using Claude inline, it's almost definitely drawing with svg's instead of calling an image generation tool. You're never going to get anything even remotely decent that way. You need a proper pipeline for assets and a full IDE to actually write code, not just chatting with Claude

replies.author: BloodMossHunter
replies.body: thanks ill ask claude how to do this

replies.author: BloodMossHunter
replies.body: not true.. hes creative enough - turns out it was the problem that hes limited by the engine. i would have to make own sprites an insert them

replies.author: Undergroundies
replies.body: Thanks, you just further proved to my point.

replies.body: well now ive found he CAN make updated sprites too.. he made them for me.. they looked soso but they were new sprites and i did insert them into the game
